scope: Porting review, against the Laguna S 2.1 branch that DStudio builds for its Laguna target, of every main commit between the recorded base and tip that the ds4 main targets integrate. One verdict per commit, from reading its first-parent diff and the Laguna sources. Not a port, a behavioural test or a release qualification.
limitations: Verdicts are source judgments recorded for this review (first-parent diffs read against the laguna-s2.1 sources at 448d569 and DStudio's Laguna patches); they were not independently re-reviewed; no engine, model or test was run and nothing was ported.

not-applicable for Laguna can also mean that the Laguna branch has the code but the Laguna target never executes it: other model families behind DS4_MODEL_FAMILY dispatch, SSD expert streaming, tensor parallelism, distributed inference, layer slicing and multi-GPU placement (all refused for Laguna in ds4_engine_open_internal), DSpark, or DeepSeek DSML syntax. Such code would matter again only if that refusal or dispatch changed.

A candidate says the Laguna branch has the same code path and lacks the change; it is not a measured defect on Laguna weights, and porting it needs its own adaptation, tests and a versioned patch under patch/.

Some not-applicable verdicts rest on how DStudio runs Laguna today, and the reason says so: Chat starts ds4-server with one slot (no --batched-session) and without --dflash, and Agent/Cowork run the JSONL agent on pipes, not the terminal UI. Changing that configuration reopens those commits.

Merges are judged by their first-parent diff, as in the inventory. A merge that only carries commits reviewed individually, or main commits before the base, gets not-applicable for itself; its conflict resolution was read with git show --remerge-diff.
Out of scope: the 311 main commits between the merge base efdadd4 and the base f4d03f6, which the Laguna branch also lacks, and every main commit after the recorded tip 890898c.
Commit titles are provenance, not verified claims.

sources.shipped: src/engines/ds4-laguna-s21 equals 448d569 file by file apart from the declared omissions (inventory shippedTrees).

verdicts.present: The same change, or an equivalent adaptation, is already in what DStudio builds for Laguna: the laguna-s2.1 branch itself or DStudio's Laguna patch set under patch/; the reason says which.
verdicts.candidate: The change applies to code the Laguna branch also has and would change what the Laguna target does on macOS/Metal; reason, fixes and laguna say what it fixes and what the Laguna code looks like.
verdicts.not-applicable: The change concerns code the Laguna branch does not have, does not build on macOS, or never executes for the Laguna target; the reason says which.
verdicts.unresolved: The source does not decide it; why says what is missing.

reviews.title: Batch DSpark seed tokens on resident DGX Spark
reviews.reason: Changes only DSpark scheduling in ds4.c (ds4_session_dspark_seed_batch_enabled, ds4_dspark_scheduler_skip_cycles, ds4_session_eval_dspark_speculative_argmax, ds4_session_eval_speculative_argmax_impl), adding a CUDA DGX Spark branch and keeping the Metal policy identical. reviews.title: Restore text-only agent tool results for DeepSeek
reviews.reason: Fixes text-only tool results in ds4_chat_append_multimodal_message for DeepSeek models without vision. Laguna 448d569 has no multimodal chat append (the function does not exist), and its agent appends tool results as plain messages.

reviews.title: Use aligned expert vector kernels for small Spark batches
reviews.reason: Adds Makefile rules for the CUDA DSpark MoE regression (tests/test_cuda_dspark_moe from cuda/mmq). CUDA-only test plumbing, absent from Laguna 448d569 and never built on macOS.

reviews.title: Keep split tool delimiters in the server sampling tracker
reviews.reason: Changes the DSML branch of dsml_decode_tracker_update in ds4_server.c (a lone "<" before a split parameter close). Laguna 448d569 has the same function, but its tracker only recognizes DSML starts (dsml_syntaxes: the two DSML spellings and <tool_calls>), and Laguna emits <tool_call> blocks, so the tracker never leaves OUTSIDE for Laguna output. It only matters for Laguna together with a port of 5b3cc8b, whose GLM tracker test relies on this lone-"<" behaviour.

reviews.title: Respect GLM tool syntax and speculative server boundaries
reviews.reason: Teaches the server sampling tracker (dsml_decode_tracker_update) the GLM <tool_call>/<arg_key>/<arg_value> grammar, keeps reasoning text out of syntax sampling, and handles speculative tokens at tool/control stops. Laguna 448d569 renders and parses tool calls with the GLM grammar (SERVER_MODEL_SYNTAX_LAGUNA goes through parse_glm_generated_message_ex), but its tracker has no model_syntax and searches only DSML starts, so Laguna tool calls are never tracked and their structure is sampled at the request temperature. A port must treat SERVER_MODEL_SYNTAX_LAGUNA like GLM (main tests only SERVER_MODEL_SYNTAX_GLM) and bring d077fa6 with it; the speculative-boundary part only runs with --dflash, which DStudio does not pass.
reviews.fixes: Tool-call names and keys are tracked and sampled greedily for GLM-syntax output, with payload sampling kept for argument values.
reviews.laguna: ds4_server.c: dsml_decode_tracker_update/dsml_find_tool_start_from know only DSML spellings; generate_job never sets a syntax on the tracker.

reviews.title: Do not repair truncated tool actions or exceed output limits
reviews.reason: Two parts. The try_repair_dsml change is DSML-only and does not affect Laguna (its <tool_call> text has no DSML tags to count). The other part keeps finish=length and skips the invalid-tool recovery when the output limit was reached. Laguna 448d569 generate_job runs continue_after_invalid_dsml for any unterminated or unparsable tool call in a non-streaming request, including Laguna syntax, and decode_again resets completion and max_tokens, so a call cut off by max_tokens triggers a second full-budget generation. Non-streaming requests only.
reviews.fixes: A tool call truncated by the output or context limit is reported as finish=length instead of being followed by a tool-error continuation that exceeds the client budget.
reviews.laguna: ds4_server.c generate_job: recovery branches after saw_tool_start && !saw_tool_end and after a failed parse do not check finish == "length"; decode_again re-reads j->req.max_tokens.

reviews.title: Keep literal tool and thinking markers inside argument data
reviews.reason: Main searches tool and thinking control markers only outside argument key/value bodies (find_tool_structural_text) and derives completed calls from the tracker. Laguna 448d569 parses Laguna tool calls with the shared parse_glm_generated_message_ex, which uses find_last_substr(text, "</think>") and strstr(p, "</tool_call>"), and its loop stops decoding as soon as observe_tool_markers (plain find_any_tool_end) sees "</tool_call>"; an argument that contains "</tool_call>" or "</think>" (for example a file being written) ends generation mid-argument or drops the call. The parser part applies to Laguna unchanged; the observe_tool_markers part needs 5b3cc8b extended to SERVER_MODEL_SYNTAX_LAGUNA.
reviews.fixes: Literal </tool_call>, </think> or <think> inside a GLM-syntax argument no longer truncates, stops or misparses the tool call.
reviews.laguna: ds4_server.c: parse_glm_generated_message_ex (strstr for tool_end, find_last_substr for </think>), observe_tool_markers and the saw_tool_end stop in generate_job.

reviews.title: Preserve literal tool data across agent and server rendering
reviews.reason: Main stops HTML-unescaping tool argument bodies and escapes only each body's own closing delimiter (new ds4_tool_text.h, absent from Laguna). Laguna 448d569 renders Laguna/GLM argument bodies escaping only the closing tag (append_glm_tag_body_text), but parses them with dsml_unescape_text, which decodes every entity (& < > " '), so a Laguna tool argument that contains a literal entity (HTML, XML, escaped code) reaches the client altered, in parse_glm_generated_message_ex and in the OpenAI/Anthropic tool streams. In the Agent, Laguna's agent_glm_tool_parse (not modified by DStudio's laguna.patch) reports "unterminated <arg_value>" as soon as a value contains a literal </tool_call>. The ds4.c hunk (bpe_tokenize_wrapped_payload_text) is DeepSeek/GLM wrapping; Laguna uses laguna_chat_append_tool_response.
reviews.fixes: Tool argument text survives render/parse/stream round trips byte for byte, and the agent no longer rejects arguments containing a literal </tool_call>.
reviews.laguna: ds4_server.c: dsml_unescape_text in parse_glm_generated_message_ex, openai_tool_emit_string_value, anthropic_tool_emit_string_value; ds4_agent.c: agent_glm_tool_parse error on strstr(close) inside a value.

reviews.title: Report tool observation errors without compacting the conversation
reviews.reason: Separates image/rendering failures from context exhaustion in agent_tool_observation_fits. Laguna 448d569's ds4_agent.c has no multimodal tool observation (no agent_tool_observation_* functions or vision spans), and DStudio runs Laguna text-only.

reviews.title: Keep valid opportunistic drafts across tool sampling boundaries
reviews.reason: Restricts the speculative resample at parser-mode boundaries to DSpark exact sampling (new ds4_engine_mtp_exact_sampling, reading e->dspark_exact_sampling) in main's opportunistic-draft loops of ds4_agent.c and ds4_server.c. Laguna 448d569 has neither that resample logic nor opportunistic drafting (its server speculates only at temperature <= 0 through DFlash), and DStudio does not pass --dflash.

reviews.title: Bound tool recovery by the request budget and explicit stops
reviews.reason: Bounds the invalid-tool recovery by the remaining output budget (server_decode_budget, recovery_completion), skips it after a client stop sequence, and replaces a malformed-DSML log scan whose bound text.len - 20 underflows for short output. Laguna 448d569 generate_job has the same recovery with decode_again resetting max_tokens to j->req.max_tokens, and the same debug scan (for p < text.len - 20), whose bound underflows for outputs shorter than 20 bytes and lets it read past the buffer when no tool-start marker is found. Applies to Laguna syntax unchanged; recovery is non-streaming only.
reviews.fixes: Tool-error recovery cannot exceed the client output budget or override a client stop, and the malformed-tool debug scan cannot read past a short output.
reviews.laguna: ds4_server.c generate_job: decode_again budget reset and the dsml_start search loop with text.len - 20.

reviews.title: Run frontend regressions without loading a model
reviews.reason: Adds a test-frontends Makefile target and makes test objects depend on ds4_tool_text.h. Test plumbing only; Laguna 448d569 has no ds4_tool_text.h and no Laguna runtime is affected.

reviews.title: Let parallel Metal prefill reads run without serial read-ahead
reviews.reason: Drops the serial read-ahead in ds4_gpu_stream_expert_cache_prepare_selected_batch (ds4_metal.m), the SSD expert-cache batch loader. Laguna 448d569 has the same function, but its callers in the GLM routed MoE take it only when g_ssd_streaming_mode is set, and the Laguna engine refuses --ssd-streaming at open (ds4.c ds4_engine_open_internal, 448d569), so g_ssd_streaming_mode stays 0.

reviews.title: Keep static Metal streaming weights resident within the runtime budget
reviews.reason: Both hunks (ds4_engine_print_startup_memory and the mlock of static weights in ds4_engine_open_internal) are guarded by e->ssd_streaming. Laguna 448d569 cannot reach them: the Laguna block of ds4_engine_open_internal refuses --ssd-streaming, layer slicing, distributed inference, tensor parallelism and multi-GPU placement, and also MTP/DSpark, steering and power caps (ds4.c around lines 59484-59510 at 448d569).

reviews.title: Use the available Metal cache and overlap the first GLM streaming prefill
reviews.reason: Changes the SSD streaming cache planner (ds4_engine_configure_streaming_auto_cache, ds4_engine_configure_streaming_cache_budget) and GLM streaming prefill (glm_graph_*). reviews.reason: Changes only GLM graph or GLM attention code (ds4.c:glm_graph_use_dense_compact_attention_prefill); a Laguna session never runs the GLM graph (sessions dispatch on DS4_MODEL_FAMILY and the Laguna graph uses its own laguna_* attention kernels), and the Laguna branch lacks some of these functions entirely.

reviews.title: Reuse GLM router readback during IQ2 expert streaming
reviews.reason: The new branch in ds4_metal.m:ds4_gpu_routed_moe_one_tensor is taken only with use_stream_expert_cache (SSD expert streaming), and that entry point is the DeepSeek routed MoE, which the Laguna graph does not call (it uses ds4_gpu_glm_routed_moe_*); the Laguna engine also refuses --ssd-streaming at open.

reviews.title: Use more of the safe Metal working set for DeepSeek expert caching
reviews.reason: Changes the SSD auto-cache percentage and model limit (ds4_ssd_auto_cache_plan in ds4_ssd.c, ds4_engine_configure_streaming_auto_cache in ds4.c) plus a test rule. In Laguna 448d569 the planner returns before any of this when !e->ssd_streaming, and the Laguna block of ds4_engine_open_internal refuses --ssd-streaming, layer slicing, distributed inference, tensor parallelism and multi-GPU placement, and also MTP/DSpark, steering and power caps (ds4.c around lines 59484-59510 at 448d569).

reviews.title: Let Metal expert caching adapt beyond the built-in preload ranking
reviews.reason: Every behavioural change is in the SSD expert-streaming path (ds4.c:metal_graph_streaming_builtin_hotness, ds4.c:metal_graph_streaming_expert_hotlist_load_default, ds4.c:metal_graph_seed_streaming_expert_cache_layer_from_mapped_hotlist); the Laguna engine refuses --ssd-streaming in ds4_engine_open_internal (448d569), so Laguna on Metal always runs resident and never reaches it.

reviews.title: Age Metal expert caches from the first routed layer
reviews.reason: Starts the expert-cache aging clock at the first routed layer (ds4_gpu_stream_expert_cache_note_token, now called from ds4_gpu_glm_routed_moe_one_tensor, which the Laguna graph uses) and adds the test-metal-ssd-experts target. Both cache-clock functions return at once unless g_ssd_streaming_mode is set, and the Laguna engine refuses --ssd-streaming at open (ds4.c ds4_engine_open_internal, 448d569), so g_ssd_streaming_mode stays 0; Laguna decode is unchanged.

reviews.title: Bound Metal streaming model views without losing auxiliary mappings
reviews.reason: Every behavioural change in ds4_metal.m:ds4_gpu_set_model_map_spans and ds4.c:glm_graph_warm_compact_indexer_store is conditional on SSD streaming mode (g_ssd_streaming_mode / g->ssd_streaming), which the Laguna engine refuses at open; the third hunk only relabels a memory-report counter.

reviews.title: Read full IQ2 GLM layers ahead during large continued prefills
reviews.reason: Changes only GLM graph or GLM attention code (ds4.c:glm_graph_forward_indexed_tokens); a Laguna session never runs the GLM graph (sessions dispatch on DS4_MODEL_FAMILY and the Laguna graph uses its own laguna_* attention kernels), and the Laguna branch lacks some of these functions entirely.

reviews.title: Remove managed-storage notifications from shared Metal buffers
reviews.reason: Removes didModifyRange calls on shared Metal buffers. In Laguna 448d569 those calls sit only in the SSD expert-cache helpers (ds4_gpu_stream_*), which need streaming that Laguna refuses, and in the DeepSeek PRO Q4 expert tables (ds4_gpu_q4_expert_table/_address_table, preloaded only for 384-expert Q4_K layers and read by ds4_gpu_routed_moe_*), which the Laguna graph does not call.

reviews.title: Align Metal GLM attention scratch for arbitrary context lengths
reviews.reason: Changes only GLM graph or GLM attention code (ds4_metal.m:ds4_gpu_glm_attention_full_tensor, ds4_metal.m:ds4_gpu_glm_attention_indexed_decode_typed_tensor); a Laguna session never runs the GLM graph (sessions dispatch on DS4_MODEL_FAMILY and the Laguna graph uses its own laguna_* attention kernels), and the Laguna branch lacks some of these functions entirely.

reviews.title: Reuse cached IQ2 experts for small Metal GLM prefills
reviews.reason: Adds a cached-IQ2 expert path to ds4_gpu_routed_moe_batch_tensor gated by g_ssd_streaming_mode, an EXPERT_ADDRESSES template flag (default false) to kernel_mul_mm_id/_mpp with new instantiations, and a resource-list variant of ds4_gpu_encode_mul_mm_id_mapped_tile whose old entry point forwards with no resources. Laguna's GLM grouped MoE keeps calling the old entry point and the existing instantiations, and streaming is refused for Laguna, so nothing it executes changes.

reviews.title: Fix agent terminal redraws, Unicode input and Markdown rendering
reviews.reason: Terminal-only changes: linenoise redraw and Unicode width handling, the interactive editor and footer, and the Markdown renderer. In Laguna 448d569 the renderer formats Markdown only when stdout is a TTY (format_markdown = use_color = isatty), and DStudio runs the Laguna Agent/Cowork as --non-interactive --jsonl subprocesses on pipes, so neither the line editor nor the Markdown path runs.

reviews.title: Make agent file tools and background shell jobs reliable
reviews.reason: Reliability fixes to the agent's own tools: atomic file replacement with concurrent-change checks, bounded reads with exact continuation (and a 128 KiB result limit that now reports truncation), searches that report incomplete coverage, bash jobs drained and timed out independently of model progress, integer schemas. Laguna 448d569's ds4_agent.c has the same tool implementations (agent_read_range, agent_write_file_bytes, agent_tool_search, agent_bash_*), from which DStudio builds its Laguna Agent/Cowork. DStudio's laguna.patch rewrites the read/more/write/list region (Laguna lines 6272-6555) and agent_execute_tool_call, so a port must be merged with that patch rather than applied as is.
reviews.fixes: File writes/edits are atomic and detect concurrent changes; reads, searches and background shell jobs no longer silently truncate or stall.
reviews.laguna: ds4_agent.c: agent_read_range/agent_write_file_bytes (rewritten in part by patch/ds4-agent-jsonl/laguna.patch), agent_tool_search, agent_bash_start/drain/poll/observation.

reviews.title: dspark: stop verification at the first EOS
reviews.reason: Truncates a DSpark verification block at the first EOS inside ds4_session_eval_dspark_speculative_argmax. Laguna's speculative path in Laguna 448d569 is DFlash (ds4_session_eval_dflash_speculative_argmax), and the Laguna block of ds4_engine_open_internal refuses --ssd-streaming, layer slicing, distributed inference, tensor parallelism and multi-GPU placement, and also MTP/DSpark, steering and power caps (ds4.c around lines 59484-59510 at 448d569).

reviews.title: rocm: align DSpark target features and retain their rolling window
reviews.reason: ROCm gfx1151 alignment of DSpark target features and ring maintenance (metal_graph_*dspark*, ds4_session_prepare_dspark_draft_impl, ds4_session_eval_speculative_argmax_impl). DSpark is DeepSeek V4 Flash draft decoding; Laguna 448d569 never runs it for Laguna (the Laguna block of ds4_engine_open_internal refuses --ssd-streaming, layer slicing, distributed inference, tensor parallelism and multi-GPU placement, and also MTP/DSpark, steering and power caps (ds4.c around lines 59484-59510 at 448d569)).

reviews.title: Merge PR #992: ROCm gfx1151 prefill and DSpark improvements
reviews.reason: Merge of PR #992: carries no change of its own beyond 394865c and 7a8c1b2 (reviewed individually) and three ROCm/CUDA-only commits of this interval (e83b106, 1ef9bba, 64e490b); its conflict resolution (git show --remerge-diff) only combines two DSpark fallback conditions in ds4_session_eval_speculative_argmax_impl, a path Laguna sessions never take in Laguna 448d569.

reviews.title: Initialize the terminal escape buffer for GCC dataflow checks
reviews.reason: Initializes a linenoise escape-sequence buffer in linenoiseEditFeed to quiet a GCC dataflow warning. linenoise serves only the interactive line editor; DStudio runs the Laguna Agent non-interactively over JSONL, and Apple clang builds are unaffected.

reviews.title: Keep ROCm QA builds clean for partial tiles and CPU-only fixtures
reviews.reason: Narrows an #ifdef DS4_ROCM_BUILD block in ds4_engine_open_internal to builds with a GPU; the code is compiled only for ROCm, never for the macOS Metal build.

reviews.title: Preserve the final byte of in-memory session snapshots
reviews.reason: ds4_session_save_snapshot in Laguna 448d569 sizes the fmemopen buffer to exactly the payload (fmemopen(snap->ptr, bytes, "wb")), the defect main fixes by reserving one byte for the terminator fmemopen may write; Laguna sessions do produce snapshots (ds4_session_payload_bytes/save_payload have a Laguna branch). In the Laguna tree only ds4-bench calls this API; DStudio's Laguna Chat server, Agent/Cowork (PLD is unavailable for Laguna) and Design do not, so for the DStudio target the defect is latent.
reviews.fixes: An in-memory session snapshot can lose its final byte when fmemopen appends its NUL terminator inside the payload buffer.
reviews.laguna: ds4.c:ds4_session_save_snapshot allocates and opens exactly payload_bytes (same code as main before c0a6119); callers in Laguna 448d569: ds4_bench.c only.

reviews.title: Bound GLM SSD prefill cache priorities so decode can adapt
reviews.reason: Every behavioural change is in the SSD expert-streaming path (ds4.c:glm_graph_seed_streaming_expert_cache_from_full_layer); the Laguna engine refuses --ssd-streaming in ds4_engine_open_internal (448d569), so Laguna on Metal always runs resident and never reaches it.

reviews.title: agent: add opt-in programming hints
reviews.reason: Adds an opt-in /hints slash command (off by default, runtime-only, never persisted) that appends teaching instructions to the agent context. It fixes nothing in Laguna 448d569's agent and changes no behaviour unless a user enables it.

reviews.title: Preserve live vision context across server tool calls
reviews.reason: Vision plumbing for server tool calls: image tool results in Responses/Anthropic, an image-embedding cache and image-aware visible-prefix keys. Laguna 448d569's ds4_server.c has no image request path (no request_tokenize_multimodal_prompt, server_image_input or vision engine), and DStudio runs Laguna text-only.

reviews.title: Keep agent tasks running across context compaction
reviews.reason: Not in the upstream Laguna branch, but an equivalent adaptation is in DStudio's Laguna patch set: patch/ds4-agent-jsonl README version 99 "backports the text-only continuation from upstream e33a5b2" to Laguna 448d569, and laguna.patch carries its pieces (agent_compact_reserve_tokens, agent_worker_append_user, agent_compact_summary_budget, the bounded summary_bottom prefix, carried_generation, open-assistant resumption, the "Do not solve unfinished tasks" summary rule, compaction lookahead). The image-boundary parts do not apply to text-only Laguna.

reviews.reason: Gives /hints asides (6546ae5) a distinct label in the terminal Markdown renderer. Depends on an opt-in feature Laguna lacks and on TTY rendering, which DStudio's non-interactive JSONL Laguna Agent does not use.

reviews.title: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash support for Metal
reviews.reason: Adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Metal. Every edit to shared code is gated on DS4_MODEL_FAMILY_DEEPSEEK41 or ds4_session_is_ds41 (vocab_load, chat prefixes, payload save/load, engine open checks, session create/sync/eval), on SSD streaming or TP, or adds new think levels Laguna's frontends never produce; the rest is new V4.1 code, Engram, image and download files the Laguna branch does not have (it forked at efdadd4 on July 20).

reviews.reason: DeepSeek V4.1 on CUDA and CUDA network tensor parallelism: CUDA/TP-only Makefile rules, ds4.c changes gated on V4.1, CUDA or tp_shard, and a refactor of TP teardown into ds4_engine_tp_unbind that is a no-op without a TP context. the Laguna block of ds4_engine_open_internal refuses --ssd-streaming, layer slicing, distributed inference, tensor parallelism and multi-GPU placement, and also MTP/DSpark, steering and power caps (ds4.c around lines 59484-59510 at 448d569).

reviews.reason: Overlaps CUDA SSD expert reads with V4.1 prefill (ds41_graph_prefill_sweep in ds4.c) and declares a cache-count query in ds4_gpu.h; CUDA, V4.1 and SSD streaming only, none of which the Laguna target on Metal runs.

reviews.reason: Changes only DeepSeek V4.1 code (ds4.c:ds41_prefill_count), compiled under DS4_HAS_DEEPSEEK41_GPU or kept in V4.1-only files; the Laguna branch forked from main at efdadd4 (July 20) and has no V4.1 graph, kernels, drafter or Engram reader (V4.1 reached main with bd66c40 on September 12).
